name: A_INGEST_ATTACHMENT
description: Fetch chat attachments (Discord/Mattermost file uploads) and fold their TEXT content into the `text` field so downstream blocks (A_EXTRACT_IOCS, triage) see a dropped .eml / .txt / .csv the same as pasted text. Reads `attachments` (array of { name, contentType, url }). Only text-like types are decoded (text/*, message/rfc822, .eml/.txt/.csv/.log/.json); binary/image attachments are recorded as metadata, not decoded. Stub-safe: no attachments, or no `fetch` capability, → pass through unchanged. Fetch/decoder errors per attachment are recorded, never crash the flow.
